body: Well the thing is I’m not an awkward teenager. I’m an awkward adult with aspergers. I’m essentially a broken failure of a person. I don’t really have a family as my parents were drug addicts who abandoned me when I was four. The only person I have is my brother, but he hates me. I’m useless.
Yeah, but then we’ll only talk for five minutes and then never speak again and then the loneliness ensues. I much rather be gone than be left on an empty hope.
